name: sn-lab
description: An interactive local app that animates SN1 and SN2 nucleophilic substitution mechanisms. Pick a substrate, nucleophile, and solvent from a curated textbook set (or let the app suggest an example), and it predicts which mechanism dominates -- with the reasoning -- then animates the backside attack and inversion of SN2 or the carbocation intermediate of SN1, alongside a reaction-energy diagram.
